snippet.title: Beneath Europa OUT NOW
snippet.description:
This is a short atmospheric exploration/adventure game where you pilot a submarine in the depths of Europa. Be sure to follow the crew’s orders!

Get it for free on itch.io:
https://3xiled4ever.itch.io/beneath-europa

Thanks!
